Bayesian models specifications ———————————————————

# Define options for the NUTS sampler
nchains <- 4    # number of chains (at least 4 for NUTS sampling)
niter <- 10000   # number of iterations per chain
nwarm <- 5000   # number of iterations to warm up before sampling 
#4 x (10000-5000)= 20000 iterations

Burrow models dry season ——————————————————————

ph

#ph
fitGLMM1_burrow <- brm(pHlog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1|ID),
                  data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                  warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                  cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM1_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: pHlog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     1.04      0.33     0.57     1.87 1.00     6596    10974
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.41      0.74    -1.08     1.90 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.02      0.47    -0.97     0.90 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                    -0.51      1.05    -2.59     1.60 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.38      1.05    -2.46     1.70 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -0.92      1.04    -3.00     1.14 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid           0.08      0.66    -1.23     1.41 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous     0.17      0.66    -1.12     1.49 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.12      0.67    -1.19     1.43 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                         10395    10751
## B.or.NBNB                         12188    13035
## Grass.typeArid                    10802    10551
## Grass.typeCalcareous              11179    12486
## Grass.typeMountain                11417    11188
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          14374    13696
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    14125    12601
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      14352    14037
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.69      0.09     0.54     0.89 1.00    10660    12212
## 
## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
pHlog1_D2<-fitGLMM1_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "pH scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
pHlog1_D2

#obtaining HPD (HIGHEST POSTERIOR DENSITY)

## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
emmeansph3<-emmeans(fitGLMM1_burrow,pairwise~B.or.NB:Grass.type, adjust="tukey")

#obtaining ROPE (REGION OF PRACTICAL EQUIVALENCE)
fitglmm1.rg<-(ref_grid(fitGLMM1_burrow)) # having an emmgrid from the model 
ropeph1<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!!
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropeph2<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~B.or.NB), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!! 
## NOTE: Results may be misleading due to involvement in interactions
ropeph3<-rope(emmeans(fitglmm1.rg, pairwise~B.or.NB:Grass.type), ci = c(.90, .95)) #####ROPE!! 
ropeph1

fitGLMM2_burrow <- brm(conductivitylog ~ + B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM2_burrow)
##  Family: gaussian 
##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
## Formula: conductivitylog ~ +B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type + (1 | ID) 
##    Data: myData (Number of observations: 50) 
##   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 10000; warmup = 5000; thin = 1;
##          total post-warmup draws = 20000
## 
## Group-Level Effects: 
## ~ID (Number of levels: 12) 
##               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sd(Intercept)     0.65      0.28     0.23     1.33 1.00     5396     6561
## 
## Population-Level Effects: 
##                                Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat
## Intercept                          0.70      0.60    -0.48     1.88 1.00
## B.or.NBNB                         -0.29      0.52    -1.31     0.71 1.00
## Grass.typeArid                     0.13      0.85    -1.57     1.81 1.00
## Grass.typeCalcareous              -0.52      0.86    -2.21     1.14 1.00
## Grass.typeMountain                -1.47      0.86    -3.15     0.23 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          -0.08      0.73    -1.52     1.35 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    -0.16      0.72    -1.57     1.25 1.00
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain       0.24      0.73    -1.19     1.70 1.00
##                                Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## Intercept                          8553    10430
## B.or.NBNB                          8982    11482
## Grass.typeArid                     9191    11210
## Grass.typeCalcareous               9474    11179
## Grass.typeMountain                 9761    11852
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeArid          10969    12870
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeCalcareous    10664    12159
## B.or.NBNB:Grass.typeMountain      10853    12156
## 
## Family Specific Parameters: 
##       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
## sigma     0.76      0.10     0.60     0.98 1.00    11951    11820

## Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
## and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
## scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
condlog1_D2<-fitGLMM2_burrow%>%
  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "conductivity scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
condlog1_D2

fitGLMM4_burrow <- brm(Klog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)

fitGLMM5_burrow <- brm(Mglog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)

## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM5_burrow)

  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%

  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "Mg scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +

  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+

    size = 12))+

fitGLMM7_burrow <- brm(P.TUDlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)

## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM7_burrow)

  emmeans( ~ B.or.NB | Grass.type) %>%
  gather_emmeans_draws() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "P scaled" )+
  stat_halfeye() +
  stat_summary(aes(group = NA), fun = mean, geom = "line") +
  facet_grid(~ Grass.type) +
  theme_light() +
  theme (plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = (12), hjust = (0.5))) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(colour = "black", size = 12))+
  theme(axis.line.y = element_line("black")) +
  theme(panel.grid.major = element_line(colour = "white"))+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_line(colour = "white")) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey60", linetype = 2) +
  theme(legend.position="none")+
  theme(strip.text.x = element_text(
    size = 12))+
  scale_color_manual(values ="black")
Plog1_D2

fitGLMM9_burrow <- brm(TNlog ~ B.or.NB + Grass.type + B.or.NB:Grass.type+ (1|ID),
                       data = myData, family = gaussian(),
                       warmup = nwarm, iter = niter, chains = nchains,
                       control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
                       cores = min(nchains, parallel::detectCores()), seed = 321)
## Compiling Stan program...
## Start sampling
summary(fitGLMM9_burrow)

##   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity

  ggplot(aes(x = B.or.NB, y = .value)) + labs( y = "TN scaled" )+

  theme(text = element_text(size = 12)) +
